_comment: Baseline interface spec for the stream contract. Regenerate with scripts/check-interface.sh --update after intentional public interface changes.

functions.name: create_split_vest
functions.description: Create a linear vest stream whose claimable amount is split among multiple beneficiaries.

functions.name: update_stream_metadata
functions.description: Update the bounded structured metadata map for a stream.

functions.name: get_stream_metadata
functions.description: Query the structured metadata map for a stream.

functions.name: set_max_batch_size
functions.description: Admin-configurable maximum batch size, bounded to 1..=200. Default is 50.

events.name: stream_metadata_updated
events.description: Emitted when a stream's structured metadata map is updated.

events.name: max_batch_size_updated
events.description: Emitted when the admin-configurable max batch size is changed.
